pad_bindings.robot: Translate — forward on y, strafe on x
Heading — yaw on x; in head mode it poses the head
Head mode — the sticks pose the head
Body-pose mode — lean and crouch while standing
Toggle the policy on and off
Held 3 s — switch between walk and roller
Held 2 s — sit down, then power off

said.detail_switch: Learn's last lesson or Settings → Detail turns them on.
said.not_a_model: No model was asked. This is a fixed list of words matched against the drive limits this app already enforces, which is why it works on a phone with nothing configured.
said.say_it_caption: Your words become a list of commands. You see the numbers before anything moves.
said.say_it_placeholder: forward for two seconds then turn left

quoted.ball_controls_clause: Standing still and both of Pollen's kick policies chase nothing at all; walking straight ahead takes 4 of the 9 core cells and 1 of the 5 extended
quoted.ball_rows_said: Four control rows and no entries.
quoted.ball_why_not_the_reward: The nine reward terms are the reward these policies were trained on, and they are reported so an edit can be watched moving them. They are not the verdict: a shaped sum of nine weighted terms is not a thing a person can hold in their head, and a leaderboard sorted on it would reward a duck that stands beautifully still.
quoted.eight_rollouts_clause: the four authored stair motions in this app get up their flight 0 times in 16
quoted.independence: Microduck Studio is an independent project. It is not made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Pollen Robotics. Microduck is their robot; this is an independent owner's app for it.
quoted.stairs_bar: The bar is 7 of the 9 core cells, cleared and still standing. Nothing has met it: the record is 5 of 9 at a 60 mm rise, and round six measured the trunk's peak height as the reason 7 was never reachable at this scale. A robot with a 10 mm shorter neck link reached a 6 of 9 ceiling in simulation on 2026-09-07, still short of 7.
quoted.stairs_criterion: honest: at the scored instant the trunk is upright, past the riser at x > 120 mm, more than 95 mm above the tread, with at least two feet resting on a tread (past the riser, within 5 mm below to 45 mm above it, and within 3 mm of a step), and the duck never left the 340 mm-wide flight at any tick of the episode. stable: honest, and upright for at least 45 of the 50 tail ticks.
quoted.stairs_rows_said: Nineteen rows are published: sixteen entries, two of them reference oracles, and three reference controls, with the intent files they name, byte for byte as the audit ran them.
quoted.submission_what_is_sent: The file holds the move, all fourteen per-cell answers unrounded, the bench's plant digest and the date. It is written to this device and nothing is sent until you pick where it goes.

quoted_when_shipped.no_pass_at_k: pass at k is not offered. It estimates how often a success would appear in k independent draws, and these epochs are not draws. They are a fixed list of drop heights the bench walks in order, so the estimator's assumption is false here and its number would look like a probability without being one.
quoted_when_shipped.no_seed_said: No seed was recorded, because no route on this bench reads one and a seed here would name a control nothing used. What varies between the epochs of a scene is the height the duck is dropped from, and every height is listed.

restated.ball_caveat_raw: Pollen's ball is not this ball. The kick config was trained against a 70 mm, 15 g ball; this plant's is 100 mm and 30 g — 1.43× the radius and twice the mass. Every reward term below is the config's own function at the config's own weight, evaluated on a different ball, so a speed in m/s is not comparable with anything Pollen published.
restated.ball_criterion_raw: chased: the duck touched the ball — any duck geometry within 3 mm of it at any tick — and the ball finished at least 100 mm further along the duck's initial heading than it started, and the duck was still upright at the end of the episode. stable: chased, and upright for at least 45 of the 50 tail ticks.
restated.ball_leaderboard_raw: Four control rows, no entries. Standing still and both of Pollen's kick policies chase nothing at all; walking straight ahead takes 4 of the 9 core cells and 1 of the 5 extended — the whole −20° column and dead-ahead at 0.45 m, because the gait drifts about 15° right — and misses the ball dead ahead at 0.70 and 0.95 m. Every cell it misses needs steering, and nothing bundled steers.
restated.ball_one_sentence_raw: Get the duck to reach a ball and move it in simulation — from wherever the ball is put down, up to 1.2 m away and up to 40° off the duck's heading — and stay standing.
restated.eight_rollouts_raw: Eight rollouts at different drop heights, because one that stays up proves very little — the four authored stair motions in this app get up their flight 0 times in 16.
restated.stairs_one_sentence_raw: Get the duck from the floor onto a step in simulation and leave it standing there — upright on the tread with both feet resting on it, fifty ticks after your move ends.
